note: Roster is data. Adding an agent is an edit HERE, never in the page markup. An entry with no sheet renders a labelled placeholder — degraded, not broken.
_background: Must match the flat backdrop baked into the sheets, so the dark padding around each room cell disappears. Resample if the art is regenerated.

sheetDefaults._top: px of title banner at the top of each sheet, excluded from the frame grid
sheetDefaults._workLoop: Frame ORDER for the working loop. The renders are variations, not curated keyframes — reorder here until the loop reads smoothly. Code never hardcodes a frame count.
